description: Read a building SPACEXPLORATION already has, by the hashid that look_up_parcel returns or that a building page URL (/parcel/{hashid}/...) contains. Returns the same data as look_up_parcel: the address and building page URL, the FEMA flood zone and natural hazard risk, EPA records nearby, Census demographics, access and nearby amenities, the county public record with numbered sources where research has found it, and any live listings in it. It looks nothing up and starts nothing, so use it to check on a building whose status.gathering or status.researching_county_record was true.

hashid.description: The building's short hashid (e.g. "k3m9x2qa"), as returned by look_up_parcel in parcel.hashid.

name: get_parcel
title: Get building
